title: Validation failures return 422, not the 400 the spec's how-to-verify note cites
evidence: src/book_api/handler.clj:19 validation-response uses status 422; REQUIREMENTS.json R9 how_to_verify says 'rejected (400)'
suggestion: 422 Unprocessable Entity is a defensible choice for semantic validation, but if strict 400 compatibility matters, return 400 for missing title/author

title: Robust routing and error handling beyond the spec
evidence: src/book_api/handler.clj:88 returns 405 for unsupported methods, 400 for malformed JSON bodies (handler.clj:38), 404 for unknown routes and non-numeric ids (handler.clj:95), and a top-level try/catch returns 500 (handler.clj:118)
